description: This file defines the AWS Backup Search client class, including method signatures for interacting with the AWS Backup Search service. It extends the AwsClient class and specifies methods for various backup search operations, including starting, stopping, listing, and tagging search jobs.

classes.name: BackupSearchClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Backup Search service, providing methods to manage search jobs and resources.

methods.name: getSearchJob
methods.description: Retrieve details about a specific search job.

methods.name: getSearchJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieve details about a specific search job.

methods.name: getSearchResultExportJob
methods.description: Retrieve details about a search result export job.

methods.name: getSearchResultExportJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieve details about a search result export job.

methods.name: listSearchJobBackups
methods.description: List backups associated with search jobs.

methods.name: listSearchJobBackupsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously list backups associated with search jobs.

methods.name: listSearchJobResults
methods.description: List results of search jobs.

methods.name: listSearchJobResultsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously list results of search jobs.

methods.name: listSearchJobs
methods.description: List all search jobs.

methods.name: listSearchJobsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously list all search jobs.

methods.name: listSearchResultExportJobs
methods.description: List search result export jobs.

methods.name: listSearchResultExportJobsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously list search result export jobs.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: List tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously list tags for a resource.

methods.name: startSearchJob
methods.description: Initiate a new search job.

methods.name: startSearchJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously initiate a new search job.

methods.name: startSearchResultExportJob
methods.description: Start a search result export job.

methods.name: startSearchResultExportJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously start a search result export job.

methods.name: stopSearchJob
methods.description: Stop an ongoing search job.

methods.name: stopSearchJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously stop a search job.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Add tags to a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously add tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Remove tags from a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously remove tags from a resource.
